senses.gloss: Tittira, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 578 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 50, 2084 (in the army of Yudhishṭhira).--§ 585 (do.): VI, 90, 3975 (ºjāḥ, sc. aśvāḥ).
Tittiri^1, a certain breed of horses: II, 1043, 1056, 1824, 2083; III, 4015; VII, 958 (C. has Tittira-); XII, 4560 (cf. prec. and V, 2228).

Tittiri^3, a brahman, brother of Vaiśampāyana. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 107 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).-§ 717c (Uparicara): XII, 337, 12760 (Vaiśampāyanapūrvajaḥ, among the sadasyas at the sacrifice of Vasu Uparieara).
